name: Fiji (Kingdom, 1871–1874)
description: A vertical bicolour of white at the hoist and light blue at the fly, charged at the centre with a red shield bearing a white dove with an olive branch, surmounted by a crown.
history: Adopted with the constitution of the Kingdom of Fiji, in which the island chiefs united under Cakobau on 5 June 1871. The kingdom ended when Cakobau ceded Fiji to Britain on 10 October 1874; the dove and shield reappeared in the arms of the colony and of modern Fiji.

features.role: shield with dove and olive branch, crowned
features.symbolism: the dove of peace, taken from the emblem of the Wesleyan mission
